cards.title: Phase-appropriate fidelity
applicability_conditions: The current stage needs to prove a bounded causal property rather than production fidelity itself.
The current artifact's cost, delay, or fragility is material relative to that stage goal.
A lower-fidelity substitute can preserve the decisive property under test.
counter_conditions: Fidelity itself is the property under test.
The substitute would remove a decisive causal property.
The intended completion claim already requires the production-real object.
cards.reasoning_cue: Name the causal property this stage must prove. Consider the lowest-sufficient-fidelity substitute that preserves it, then bridge back to the production-real object before broadening the completion claim.
